page.layout: One page of text, full width: running head at top with page number at left; running text in justified lines; a centred title line in large italic capitals with a subtitle in small capitals below; below that a faint table or list of short lines at the right, with the bottom of the page largely blank and faint. No marginal notes legible.

main_text.p: quoque laetus de monasterio abscessit. Contigit autem ista ordinatio circa finem anni ab incarnatione Domini DCCCLXXXIII. VI. feria, VIII. Idus Decembris, indictione prima: anno vero Karoli Imperatoris tertio, super omnia vero regnante Domino nostro Iesu Christo, cui est honor & gloria per indeficientia secula, Amen.
main_text.head: EXPLICIT RATPERTVS: INCIPIT EKKEHARDVS.

page.notes: The lower half of the page is very faint; the short lines at the right beneath the title are largely illegible and are not transcribed. The line "Ekke-" is a partly legible fragment. The word "indeficientia" is printed as shown; "laetus" is read as "lætus" with a ligature possibly lost; the first word may be "quoque" with a doubtful initial letter.
